name: kstock-mcp
description: Read-only Korean stock tools: KIS quotes, charts and balance, OpenDART disclosures and financials, IPO schedule with equal-allocation estimate.
long_description: K-Stock MCP connects Claude to the Korean stock market. It reads quotes, order books, candles and account balance from the Korea Investment & Securities (KIS) Open API, disclosures and key financials from OpenDART, and shows the IPO (공모주) schedule with an optional equal-allocation (균등배정) estimate. It defaults to KIS paper (mock) trading. It has no order tools and gives no buy/sell recommendations. Everything returned is informational data, not investment advice; investment decisions are your own responsibility.

tools.name: search_stock
tools.description: Find Korean listed securities by name or code.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Current price, day range, valuation ratios and order book.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Holdings and account summary for the configured KIS account (read-only).

tools.name: get_ipo_schedule
tools.description: Upcoming IPO schedule from OpenDART filings, with optional equal-allocation estimate.

tools.name: get_disclosure
tools.description: Recent DART disclosures for a company.

tools.name: get_financials
tools.description: Key financial statement accounts from DART.
